page_title: REI 2-0 CLE | Reims v Clermont 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
90+5' Jeremie Bela (Clermont) will take a corner kick.
90+3' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+3' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
90+2' Looks like Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

88' Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
87' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Mateusz Wieteska will be replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marshall Munetsi departs the field of play to be replaced by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims).
85' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Junya Ito sprays a pass out to Mohamed Daramy (Reims), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
85' No offside! Referee Romain Lissorgue points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Reims players celebrate.
85' Wait! Referee Romain Lissorgue immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
84' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mohamed Daramy (Reims) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
83' Junya Ito (Reims) tries to find Marshall Munetsi, but he puts too much power on the pass.
81' Jeremie Bela (Clermont) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
78' Clermont work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

77' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) receives a quality pass inside the box and unleashes a first-time effort. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the goalkeeper. Mory Diaw pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Marshall Munetsi (Reims) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the middle of the goal, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
76' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jeremie Bela (Clermont), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amir Richardson leaves the pitch and Teddy Teuma (Reims) comes on.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) will replace Oumar Diakite.
72' Pascal Gastien has decided to substitute Jim Allevinah and he is replaced by Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
72' Substitution. Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mehdi Zeffane walks off.
70' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
68' A pass from Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is intercepted by Mory Diaw and the move breaks down.
67' Oumar Diakite (Reims) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
62' Substitution. Komnen Andric (Clermont) has come on for Grejohn Kyei.
62' Substitution. Yohan Magnin (Clermont) on for Johan Gastien.
61' William Still prepares a substitution. Keito Nakamura is replaced by Mohamed Daramy (Reims).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Thibault De Smet (Reims) is coming onto the pitch as Josh Wilson-Esbrand cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Keito Nakamura (Reims) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
56' Good defending. Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) tries to find Muhammed Cham inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
54' The game is interrupted as Junya Ito (Reims) is flagged offside.
52' Amir Richardson (Reims) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
51' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle after Alidu Seidu (Clermont) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Reims have a free kick.
51' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) plays a long ball to Oumar Diakite, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
48' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
47' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) sends a long ball forward to Jim Allevinah, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Johan Gastien (Clermont) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+4' Neto Borges (Clermont) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Clermont get a corner.
45+1' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45+1' A quickly taken corner by Clermont.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Clermont are ruled offside.
43' Johan Gastien (Clermont) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
42' The corner from Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is intercepted by the defence.
41' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Good work from Clermont as they win a corner.
41' Junya Ito (Reims) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
40' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Reims.
39' Keito Nakamura (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Keito Nakamura (Reims) controls a cross inside the box and sends a shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
36' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) sends a rebound towards the right side of the target, but Yehvann Diouf reacts quickly and punches his promising attempt onto the post. Superb goalkeeping!
32' Johan Gastien (Clermont) is about to take a corner kick.

32' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Clermont can continue in their attacking effort.
30' Junya Ito (Reims) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
30' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) plays a terrific long ball forward to Oumar Diakite, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
27' 2:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
23' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
22' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is flagged offside not for the first time in this match.
20' Johan Gastien (Clermont) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.

17' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Marshall Munetsi (Reims) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Amir Richardson and scores magnificently from close range into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
17' Junya Ito (Reims) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

16' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes out of play. Reims are awarded a corner kick.

15' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
14' Mory Diaw leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Junya Ito (Reims).
13' Junya Ito (Reims) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
11' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Mory Diaw comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.

8' Amir Richardson (Reims) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Oumar Diakite (Reims) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
8' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
6' The game is interrupted now, Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
2' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
2' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick to Clermont.
1' The match has just started.
Clermont will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Romain Lissorgue.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
